sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "advisor"."i_ID" AS e, "instructor"."dept_name" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "advisor" JOIN "instructor" ON "instructor"."ID" = "advisor"."i_ID"  GROUP BY "advisor"."i_ID", "instructor"."dept_name"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of advisor records (all level)
rank within the group by number of advisor records, keep the top 3
